VI.description: Releases what a DQMH parse opened\3A Close Scripting References.vi on every module in Modules\2C then Close Reference on My Computer. A subVI of the headless DQMH wrappers\2C called once the scripting is done.\0A\0AEVERY MODULE IS CLOSED WHATEVER error in SAYS. Close Scripting References.vi is called with no incoming error and its answers are merged afterwards\2C so an earlier failure never leaves a module's references open. error out carries error in first\2C then the first close that failed.\0A\0AAn empty Modules array closes only My Computer. Generated by LabVIEWMCP\3B the Delacor VI it calls belongs to the user's DQMH installation and is not shipped with it.
